summary: Practise client fact-finds, cash-flow analysis and portfolio reviews in five days. Explore the wealth management training outline.
lede: Financial planning and wealth management connect household goals, cash flow and risk profiles to investment choices and review actions. For financial advisers, paraplanners and client-service leads, the course covers reconciling client records, prioritising goals, testing affordability and documenting an Investment Policy Statement with an asset-allocation rationale. You also practise portfolio reviews and planning client follow-up, while tax and estate coordination is introduced at overview level.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who collect client financial information, shape household plans or review wealth-management recommendations. It is designed for roles that need to connect client goals with documented cash flows, investment choices and follow-up actions.
modules: Household Balance Sheet and Client Fact-Find
Time Value of Money and Goal Funding
Investment Policy Statement and Asset Allocation
Client Review Dashboard and Advice Record
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with household budgets or client financial records is expected. No coding is required.
